capabilities: Share a Markdown folder peer to peer
Send an invitation or web link
Edit notes together with live cursors
Install and run the deepika-sync daemon
disambiguation: Not a general vault-sync or dotfile tool; it shares one folder for live co-editing.
extras: Desktop only; Linux validated, macOS experimental, Windows unsupported. Invitations grant write access to the whole folder and cannot be revoked. French documentation; no account, telemetry or ads; MIT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for several people to edit the same Markdown notes together in real time without a server.

relations.evidence: Le plugin s'appuie sur le daemon deepika-sync, qu'il lance et arrête lui-même

summary: Peer-to-peer live collaboration plugin that shares Markdown folders through a local daemon, with live cursors and browser join links.
